means.就: 就 says it happened early, quickly or easily: sooner than expected.
means.才: 才 says it happened late, slowly or with difficulty: later than expected. Before a number it can also mean 'only'.

items.en: He came early, at eight.
items.why: Earlier than expected: 就 (and 了 at the end).

items.en: He didn't come until ten.
items.why: Later than expected: 才 (no 了).

items.en: I only understood it after reading it three times.
items.why: It took a lot: 才.

items.en: I understood it after reading it once.
items.why: It was easy and quick: 就.

items.zh: 他今年[才]十岁，个子已经很高了。
items.en: He's only ten this year, but he's already tall.
items.why: Before a number, 'only': 才.

items.en: Wait a moment, I'm coming right away.
items.why: Very soon: 马上就.

items.en: Why are you only getting here now?
items.why: Later than it should be: 才.

items.en: He was already up at five in the morning.
items.why: Earlier than expected: 就…了.

items.zh: 我等了一个小时，车[才]来。
items.en: I waited an hour before the bus finally came.
items.why: It took a long time: 才.

means.再: 再 is 'again' for something that has not happened yet: next time, later, once more. It also means 'then' in 先…再….
means.又: 又 is 'again' for something that already happened again, or that will surely come round again (明天又是星期一).

items.en: Come again tomorrow.
items.why: Again, but it has not happened yet: 再.

items.zh: 他昨天来了，今天[又]来了。
items.en: He came yesterday, and he came again today.
items.why: It already happened again: 又.

items.en: Please say it once more.
items.why: Once more, from now on: 再.

items.en: Why are you late again?
items.why: It has already happened again: 又.

items.en: Tomorrow is Monday again.
items.why: Something that surely comes round again: 又, even about tomorrow.

items.zh: 我们先吃饭，[再]去看电影。
items.en: Let's eat first, then go to the cinema.
items.why: 先…再…: first … then ….

items.zh: 这个菜很好吃，我想[再]吃一碗。
items.en: This is delicious. I'd like another bowl.
items.why: Once more, not yet eaten: 再.

items.en: He forgot his phone again.
items.why: It has happened again: 又.

items.en: Let's leave after class.
items.why: Later, after something else: 再.

means.把: 把: the doer comes first and does something to the thing: 我把作业写完了 'I finished my homework'.
means.被: 被: the thing comes first and something is done to it, often something bad: 杯子被打破了 'the cup got broken'.

items.en: I've finished my homework.
items.why: The doer (我) comes first and does something to the homework: 把.

items.zh: 我的自行车[被]人骑走了。
items.en: My bike was ridden off by someone.
items.why: The thing comes first and something is done to it: 被.

items.en: Please close the door.
items.why: You do something to the door: 把.

items.en: That cake was eaten by my little brother.
items.why: The cake comes first; it got eaten: 被.

items.zh: 妈妈[把]房间打扫得很干净。
items.en: Mum cleaned the room until it was spotless.
items.why: The doer first, then what she did to the room: 把.

items.en: His phone was taken.
items.why: The phone comes first and something bad happened to it: 被. The doer can be left out.

items.en: Where did you put your phone?
items.why: You did something to the phone (put it somewhere): 把.

items.en: That book has been borrowed by him.
items.why: The book comes first; something was done to it: 被.

items.en: He took my cup.
items.why: The doer first: 把.

means.或者: 或者 is 'or' in a statement: either one is fine.
means.还是: 还是 is 'or' in a question, including a question inside a sentence (我不知道…还是…).

items.en: Would you like tea or coffee?
items.why: A question asking you to choose: 还是.

items.zh: 你可以明天[或者]后天来。
items.en: You can come tomorrow or the day after.
items.why: A statement, either is fine: 或者.

items.zh: 你想坐飞机[还是]坐火车？
items.en: Do you want to fly or take the train?
items.why: A question: 还是.

items.zh: 周末我常常看书[或者]看电影。
items.en: At weekends I often read or watch a film.
items.why: A statement: 或者.

items.zh: 我不知道他是老师[还是]学生。
items.en: I don't know whether he's a teacher or a student.
items.why: A question inside a sentence (I don't know which): 还是.

items.zh: 你可以给我打电话[或者]发电子邮件。
items.en: You can phone me or send an email.
items.why: A statement, either way works: 或者.

items.zh: 你是今天走[还是]明天走？
items.en: Are you leaving today or tomorrow?
items.why: A question: 还是.

items.zh: 星期六[或者]星期天我去看你。
items.en: I'll come and see you on Saturday or Sunday.
items.why: A statement: 或者.

items.zh: 去不去，[还是]你自己决定吧。
items.en: Whether to go or not, you'd better decide yourself.
items.why: 还是 can also mean 'had better'; 或者 never does.

means.刚: 刚 is an adverb, 'just': it sits right before the verb and can take a length of time after the verb (刚来两天).
means.刚才: 刚才 is a time word, 'a moment ago': it can come before the person, after 比, or before 不 / 没.

items.en: Where did you go just now?
items.why: Before the person (你), only the time word 刚才 can go.

items.zh: 我[刚]来两天，还不太习惯。
items.en: I only arrived two days ago, so I'm not used to it yet.
items.why: 刚 + verb + length of time: 刚来两天.

items.zh: [刚才]我没听清楚，请再说一遍。
items.en: I didn't hear clearly just now. Please say it again.
items.why: Before 没, and at the start: 刚才.

items.zh: 我[刚]学了一个月汉语，还说得不好。
items.en: I've only been learning Chinese for a month, so I don't speak it well yet.
items.why: 刚 + verb + length of time: 刚学了一个月. 刚才 cannot take a length of time.

items.en: It's much better now than a moment ago.
items.why: After 比 you need a noun-like time word: 刚才.

items.en: I just bought this jacket.
items.why: Right before the verb, 'just': 刚. 刚才 also works here ('a moment ago').

items.en: Who was that on the phone just now?
items.why: 刚才的 describes a noun; 刚 cannot.

items.en: We've only known each other for a month.
items.why: 刚 + verb + length of time.

means.只要: 只要…就…: as long as this happens, that will follow. One easy condition is enough.
means.只有: 只有…才…: only if this happens can that follow. Nothing else will do. 只有 + person also means 'only'.

items.en: As long as you work hard, you'll learn it well.
items.why: One condition is enough, with 就: 只要.

items.en: Only with lots of practice can you speak well.
items.why: The only way, with 才: 只有.

items.en: Whenever I have time, I go to see him.
items.why: As long as: 只要…就….

items.en: Only he knows about this.
items.why: 只有 + person: only him.

items.en: As long as it doesn't rain, we'll go hiking.
items.why: As long as: 只要…就….

items.en: Only at night is it quiet here.
items.why: Only then, with 才: 只有.

items.en: If you like it, take it.
items.why: As long as you like it: 只要…就….

items.en: Only if you go yourself will you see clearly.
items.why: The only way, with 才: 只有.
